name: Lust Scripter ~Mousou no Gugensha~
source: Kamiyama is a scenario writer for a game company.  His younger sister who is still a student also works at this game company and for some reason the scenarios he writes tend to influence his sister's behavior.  He begins to develop stories that lead his sister and her friends into increasingly lewd behavior.  And so he becomes the lust scripter....
translation: 神山是一家遊戲公司的編劇。他妹妹還是學生，卻也在這家遊戲公司工作，出於某種原因，他寫的劇本往往會影響他妹妹的行為。他開始編造一些故事，導致他的妹妹和她的朋友們行為愈來愈淫蕩。於是他就成為了情慾的編劇……
